title: AlertedEvent
description: AlertedEvent schema from Varonis DatAlert API

operationType.description: Type of operation performed such as file access, permission change, or login attempt.

destinationAccount.description: Target account affected by the operation.

resource.description: Resource path or name affected by the event.

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the operation was performed.

ipReputation.description: Reputation classification of the IP address.

country.description: Country associated with the IP address.

state.description: State or region associated with the IP address.

deviceName.description: Name of the device from which the operation was performed.
